title: Site comparison respects the specified clopen alpha
statement: Let $\Lambda$ be a finite commutative ring. Let $k:V\hookrightarrow W$ and $i:S\hookrightarrow T$ be quasi-compact open immersions, let $r:V\to S$ and $p:W\to T$ be proper, and suppose $pk=ir$. Write $A_X=\nu_X^*$ for exact etale/proetale comparison, $G_f^e,G_f^p$ for inverse image and $J_j^e,J_j^p$ for extension by zero on bounded-below derived categories. Take the specified alphas $\alpha_Q^e$ [def-cbc-etale-clopen-mate-normalization-data] and $\alpha_Q^p$ [def-cbc-proetale-clopen-mate-data]. Let $o_j:A_{cod(j)}J_j^e\cong J_j^pA_{dom(j)}$ be the canonical open comparison [def-weil-pbc-proper-open-site-extension], and $a_f:A_{dom(f)}G_f^e\cong G_f^pA_{cod(f)}$ the canonical pullback comparison [lem-weil-pbc-comparison-pullback], realized by the fixed bounded-below pullback comparison [lem-weil-pbc-comparison-direct-image-canonical-mate]. For every $M\in D^+(S_{et},\Lambda)$ one has $J_k^p(a_{r,M})\circ o_{k,G_r^eM}\circ A_W(\alpha^e_{Q,M})=\alpha^p_{Q,A_SM}\circ G_p^p(o_{i,M})\circ a_{p,J_i^eM}$. This asserts only alpha transport, before taking proper mates; it includes the identity/zero normalization of the clopen projection.

source.place: Tags 099R and 09AF, with more-etale.tex Tag 0F7B; the original finite-clopen-mate-site-transport construction and proof steps 2--4.

proof.text: Factor both specified sheaf alphas as inverse cartesian open base change followed by the clopen projection and outgoing compositors. Apply beta site transport to the first factor and tail site transport to the remaining factors, then compose the two equalities. This proves the complete ordinary sheaf alpha equation without changing either alpha.

Apply the existing right-derived-plus cube to the ordinary sheaf equation, with G,H the two etale open extensions, G0,H0 their proetale counterparts, and P,Q,P0,Q0 the corresponding inverse images. For an exact square, prove its right-derived base-change expression equals the canonical exact localization by comparing their homotopy factorization equations. Use this equality at the proetale alpha and the canonical exact square comparison at the four site-comparison faces. Naturality and cancellation of the exact right-derived comparison isomorphisms reduce the cube to precisely the requested equality on D+. This step is completely proved in Lean and uses no faithfulness of derived evaluation.

theorem finiteClopenAlphaSiteTransport
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] [Finite Λ]
    {V W S T : Scheme.{u}} (k : V ⟶ W) (i : S ⟶ T) (r : V ⟶ S) (p : W ⟶ T)
    [IsOpenImmersion k] [IsOpenImmersion i] [QuasiCompact k] [QuasiCompact i]
    [IsProper r] [IsProper p] (h : k ≫ p = r ≫ i) :
    ∀ (M : DerivedCategory.Plus (Sheaf S.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ))),
      (comparisonUpperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) W).mapDerivedCategoryPlus.map
          ((Etale.ClopenMateNormalization.derivedAlphaPlus Λ k r p i h).app M) ≫
        (properOpenSiteExtensionIso Λ k).hom.app
          ((Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) r).mapDerivedCategoryPlus.obj M) ≫
        (openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) k).mapDerivedCategoryPlus.map
          ((fixedComparisonPullbackPlus Λ r).hom.app M) =
      (fixedComparisonPullbackPlus Λ p).hom.app
          ((Etale.openImmersionLowerShriek
            (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) i).mapDerivedCategoryPlus.obj M) ≫
        (upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) p).mapDerivedCategoryPlus.map
          ((properOpenSiteExtensionIso Λ i).hom.app M) ≫
        (cbcClopenAlphaPlus Λ k i r p h).app
          ((comparisonUpperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) S).mapDerivedCategoryPlus.obj M)
